item: P3-T04 — Signup partial failure recovery (L3 + F9)
mode: implement + verify ONLY; no git mutations (changes left uncommitted as instructed)

chosen_approach.A_slug: P2002 retry at the ATTEMPT level, not the statement level. Rationale: physical DB is PostgreSQL provider (prisma/schema.prisma) — a failed insert (P2002) aborts the interactive transaction, so the failing workspace.create cannot be retried inside the same tx. Bounded loop (SIGNUP_ATTEMPTS = 3) around the whole provisioning $transaction; on `isWorkspaceSlugConflict(error)` (new helper in src/server/unique.ts: P2002 + meta.target mentions 'slug') the whole attempt rolls back and the next attempt re-runs `uniqueWorkspaceSlug`, which now sees the committed winner and proposes the next free variant (base, base-1, base-2, ...). Exhaustion returns null -> neutral SIGNUP_FAILED (never a raw 500). Non-slug P2002s / other errors propagate unchanged.
chosen_approach.B_partial_failure: TRANSACTION variant (not login-recovery). Rationale: audited the signup flow — exactly three DB writes (user, workspace with nested members.create OWNER, getting-started page), nothing happens between user-create and workspace-create (no email/verification token is sent at signup — SIGNUP_FAILED doc comment confirms 'the app sends no confirmation mail on sign-up'), and createSession is a JWT cookie + non-DB session-store write that stays AFTER the transaction. Nothing non-transactional is interleaved, so prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => ...) covers everything; a mid-provision failure leaves NO user row and a retry starts clean. Login-recovery residual risk (workspace-less /app landing) is structurally eliminated instead of patched.
